# file-type-palette

The colours file-type glyphs are drawn in: one `--file-<tone>` per tone of
`primitives/file-type`'s closed `FileTone` set, plus `--folder`. Dark values
are Seti's palette; light values are those darkened (VS Code's rule), so a
theme can retune them like any other token group (customizer section "File
types").

The keys are a contract with `primitives/file-type` (`fileToneVar(tone)` names
`--file-<tone>`): adding a tone means adding its key here.
